take: Squarespace surfaces lesson state in the course outline and supports Draft, Published, or Scheduled with an inline date/time picker.
observed: Select lesson checkbox; choose Set status; select Scheduled; choose date and time; save. The row changes from DRAFT to SCHEDULED and the preview header repeats the state.
limits: Five sampled frames; no learner view, recurrence, timezone control, or per-group access is shown.

take: Teachable applies enrollment-relative drip at section level while keeping lesson publication as a separate row action.
observed: Open Drip; use Days after enrollment; enter 1; save; activate drip. The section gains an availability summary; the panel offers an optional email and shows UTC/local-time information.
limits: Six sampled frames do not prove every click, learner behavior, or per-group targeting; activating drip is not evidence that lessons are published.

take: Teachable's curriculum screen pairs per-lesson Publish buttons with a section-level drip panel offering days-after-enrollment or specific-date release.
observed: The open Drip panel names the selected section, shows Days after enrollment, a numeric delay, Save, Activate drip, and Create an email; lesson rows retain separate Publish buttons.
limits: Single frame; it does not show completing the specific-date path, learner results, or group controls.

take: Kajabi makes a lesson's binary Draft/Published state prominent beside its details.
observed: A Status card contains Draft and Published radio options; Draft is selected, and the page has Preview and Save actions.
limits: Single lesson-edit frame; no scheduling, learner result, or per-group access appears.

take: Podia changes a lesson from Hidden to visible through its row overflow menu, but does not leave a positive visible-state label.
observed: Open the kebab menu for the Hidden lesson; choose Set as visible; the Hidden label disappears. Another section is labeled Delayed 1 day, but this flow does not edit it.
limits: Three sampled frames; no draft terminology, delay setup, learner result, or per-group access is shown.
